create vlan 10,20,200,999 active
!
interface port-channel 1
mode manual
switchport trunk native vlan 999
switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,200
switchport mode trunk
!
access-list 1000
  description management
  rule 10 permit 192.0.2.0 255.255.255.0
  rule 100 deny any
!
access-list 1001
  description snmp
  rule 10 permit 192.0.2.10 255.255.255.255
  rule 100 deny any
!
access-list 3001
  rule 10 permit any any ethertype ip
  rule 20 permit any any ethertype 86dd ffff
  rule 30 permit any any ethertype arp
  rule 100 deny any any
!
user name operator password <secret:EXAMPLE_OPERATOR_PASSWORD>
enable password <secret:EXAMPLE_ENABLE>
hostname example-core-switch
clock timezone + 7 0 0
!
interface hundredgige 1/1/1

interface vlan 10
ip address 192.0.2.3 255.255.255.0
ip ospf network ptp
ip ospf cost 10
ip ospf passive-interface enable
ip ospf bfd
vrrp 1 ip 192.0.2.254
vrrp 1 timers advertise-interval 2
vrrp 1 priority 120
no vrrp 1 preempt
!
router ospf 1 router-id 192.0.2.3
network 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.255 area 0.0.0.0
redistribute connected
redistribute static
!
storm-control detection enable
transceiver ddm enable
lldp enable
spanning-tree enable
spanning-tree priority 4096
no snmp-server community public
no snmp-server community private
snmp-server access circuit read internet usm authpriv
snmp-server user monitor authentication sha <secret:EXAMPLE_SNMP_AUTH> privacy aes128 <secret:EXAMPLE_SNMP_PRIVACY>
snmp-server group circuit user monitor usm
snmp-server access-list 1001
bfd 1 bind peer-ip 192.0.2.1 interface vlan 10
session enable
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 192.0.2.1 track bfd 1
telnet-server disable
ssh2 server authentication-timeout 100
ssh2 server authentication-retries 3
ssh2 access-list 1000
ntp enable
ntp server 192.0.2.1
logging host 192.0.2.50
